title: A waxed parting in grey hair
odia:
କେମନ୍ତ କଥା
ପାକଲା ବାଳରେ ମହଣ ସୁନ୍ଥା।
literal_meaning: What is this—a waxed parting in grey hair!
meaning_odia: ପାଚିଲା ବାଳକୁ ମହଣ ଦେଇ ସୁନ୍ଥା କରି ସଜାଇବା ଦେଖି ବକ୍ତା ଆଶ୍ଚର୍ଯ୍ୟ ବା ଥଟ୍ଟା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରୁଛି। ଏହା ବକ୍ତାର ଦୃଷ୍ଟିଭଙ୍ଗୀ; ବୟସ ବଢ଼ିଲେ ସଜ ହେବା ଅନୁଚିତ ବୋଲି ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The exclamation places grey hair beside a carefully waxed parting. This edition hears surprise or teasing in that contrast: the styling appears unexpected to the speaker. The line reveals that expectation rather than establishing how someone of a particular age ought to look.
usage_example: In a fictional conversation, someone teases an older relative who has carefully styled their hair for a photograph by quoting these lines. The remark exposes the speaker’s expectations about age. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ମହଣ here means beeswax, whose use on combed hair is recorded in the inspected dictionary. ସୁନ୍ଥା is the hair parting. Together they give the image a precise grooming detail rather than a quantity or weight.
